newsitem.title: USA: Rohm & Haas says weak currencies hurt Q4 rev.
newsitem.headline: Rohm & Haas says weak currencies hurt Q4 rev.

text.p: Rohm & Hass Co said its fourth-quarter revenues in Europe and the Asia-Pacific regions were hurt by weak currencies in those areas.

The company earned $1.16 per share in the period, compared with $0.98 per share, on sales of $965 million compared with $915 million. The company also reported European sales of $228 million, compared with $229 million, and Asia-Pacific sales of $163 million, compared with $154 million a year earlier.
The company also said the European earnings were hurt by operating losses and restructuring costs related to the AtoHaas joint venture in Europe.
It added that the earnings were helped by a strong performance in the quarter from its Latin American operations.
Officials were not immediately available to comment.
